scenes.text: Here's your workspace. See what your agent has been working on this week.
Just below, you'll find the decisions waiting for your review.
Prefer a lighter view? Switch the appearance here. This workspace uses fictional data.
In this bookkeeping example, two overdue invoices need a decision. Start with the weekly overview.
Open Approvals to read the proposed reminders and the reason behind each one.
You can approve by email, ask for changes, or decline. Nothing is sent in this fictional demo.
Here's a fictional property team's workspace. Home brings the latest leads and pending decisions together.
Open Leads to see which opportunities are ready, warm, or still early, and why.
Switch to the table to compare contacts and see when each was last reached.
Then open Approvals to review the proposed outreach before it goes ahead.
Choose an email reply when you're ready. This demo stops before anything is sent.
Let's follow a roofing enquiry. Start at Home for the week's leads and decisions.
The lead board groups homeowner enquiries by priority, with a reason behind each rating.
In Approvals, read the proposed follow-up and check the context before deciding.
Approve by email, request a change, or decline. This example uses fictional data; no message is sent.
Here's a tax team's workspace, using fictional client data. The weekly overview shows what needs attention.
Open Approvals to review the missing documents and the reminders your agent has prepared.
Check the wording, then choose an email reply to approve, request changes, or decline. No email is sent in this demo.
